62' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.

53' The game is interrupted.

48' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
48' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Robert Skov (Union Berlin) is replaced by Tim Skarke.

45+4' Florian Exner blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
45+2' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) will deliver the corner kick.
45+2' A pass into the box finds Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alexander Schwolow denies him.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is cautioned by the referee.
45' 3 - 1 Spectacular goal! Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
39' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) tackles a bit over-zealously and Florian Exner blows for a foul.
30' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
29' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
28' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
23' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Tom Rothe tees up Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) inside the box and he slams the ball into the roof of the net and past Michael Zetterer.
19' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

17' 2 - 0 Goal! Derrick Kohn displays great vision and sends a pass to Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 2:0.

13' 1 - 0 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Romano Schmid is pounced on by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen). His close-range strike flashes past Alexander Schwolow and into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
9' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post!
5' Yellow card. Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
3' The ball is cleared after Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
